% remove_dups(+List, -Result): Result keeps the first occurrence of each element, in order.
remove_dups([], []).
remove_dups([H|T], Result) :-
    member(H, T),
    remove_dups(T, Result).
remove_dups([H|T], [H|Result]) :-
    \+ member(H, T),
    remove_dups(T, Result).

% insert_sorted(+X, +Sorted, -Result): inserts X into an ascending list, keeping it ascending.
insert_sorted(X, [], [X]).
insert_sorted(X, [H|T], [X, H|T]) :-
    X =< H.
insert_sorted(X, [H|T], [H|Result]) :-
    X > H,
    insert_sorted(X, T, Result).

% subset_sum(+List, +Sum, -Subset): on backtracking, gives every sublist of List (keeping order) whose elements add up to Sum.
subset_sum(List, Sum, Subset) :-
    subset_sum(List, Sum, Subset, 0).

subset_sum([], Sum, [], Acc) :-
    Acc = Sum.
subset_sum([H|T], Sum, [H|Subset], Acc) :-
    NewAcc is Acc + H,
    subset_sum(T, Sum, Subset, NewAcc).
subset_sum([_|T], Sum, Subset, Acc) :-
    subset_sum(T, Sum, Subset, Acc).
